description: Implementation of WMLTag class for reading and parsing Wesnoth WML files, managing tags, settings, and child tags.

classes.name: WMLTag
classes.description: Class to parse and represent Wesnoth WML tags, including nested tags and settings.

methods.name: initWithFile:setTag:
methods.description: Initializes WMLTag object by loading WML content from a file and setting the tag.

methods.name: initWithString:setTag:
methods.description: Main initializer that parses a WML string and sets the tag, building a hierarchy of tags and settings.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Reads the next line from the WML text, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: childrenCount
methods.description: Returns the number of child tags.

methods.name: getChildAtIndex:
methods.description: Returns the child WMLTag at the specified index.

methods.name: settingsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of settings in the tag.

methods.name: getSettingFor:
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a setting by key.
